comment: Source-based C-first monster-blindness setup: generate a hostile ogre, throw a potion of blindness to reach potion.c:potionhit and set mcansee false, then hit it with a blessed healing potion so potion.c calls mcureblindness. This setup recording exposes C-assigned item slots and the generated map before selecting the attack direction.
